name: Morris Floyd
source:
The head of the Floyd family and [url=/c166405]Donna[/url]'s father.
A farm owner who runs a large rural plantation.
He has a rough side, but is a generous person and is loved by many.
He deeply loves his family and his farm.

[Translated from the [url=https://dotaihen.xxxxxxxx.jp/tea/teaparty.htm]official website[/url]]
